title: The Pantry
what: A pronunciation dictionary for names the voice can't guess: each entry respells a word, and every line read afterwards uses it. A one-off fix can also go inline, and a word can be spelled out.

inputs.label: Entries
inputs.value: Quillowbrook → Kwill-oh-brook, Worcestershire → Wuss-ter-sher, Siobhan → Shiv-awn, Nguyen → Win, Lelelilo → Leh-leh-lee-loh, Ghoti → Fish

inputs.label: Lines
inputs.value: Siobhan drove all the way from Worcestershire to buy a jar of Quillowbrook honey. / Mister Nguyen keeps the Lelelilo biscuits behind the jar of ghoti.

inputs.label: Inline
inputs.value: The label on the top shelf says [[Tomato|Toe-mah-toe]], and Nell refuses to argue about it.

inputs.label: Numbers
inputs.value: On the 12th of March we baked 1,234 cookies by 3:45 pm, and sold them at $2.50 each.

inputs.label: Spelled
inputs.value: The jar on the top shelf is labelled [spell]JAM[/spell], but it is full of buttons. (long-form renderer)

endpoint: POST /pronunciation, then POST /generate (pronounce on or off)
checks: The dictionary entries were removed again after this room
